title: Keep the current project in the list
responsibility: Reads the connection’s project list and ensures the currently shown project appears in the project switcher.

inputs.name: projectList.projects
inputs.description: The projects supplied for the switcher, in display order. The original array and its entries are preserved when no append is needed, including any duplicates.

inputs.name: projectList.snapshot
inputs.description: The snapshot for the project currently shown in the switcher, or null when none is shown. Its optional project id falls back to an empty string, and only capabilities.source equal to github makes an appended entry shared.

inputs.name: listedProjects.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop bridge, whose listProjects method may be absent. The method is called when present; when absent, the function resolves to an empty list.

outputs.name: listedProjects
outputs.description: A promise resolving to the result of bridge.listProjects() when available or to an empty list when absent. If the bridge method throws or its promise rejects, the returned promise rejects with that reason.

outputs.name: projectList
outputs.description: The original array when the snapshot is null or its effective id is already present; otherwise a new array appends the snapshot id and name. The appended entry is shared only when capabilities.source is github, and local otherwise.

errors.name: bridge.listProjects rejection
errors.description: An exception thrown by bridge.listProjects() or a rejection from its returned promise becomes the rejection reason of listedProjects. The implementation does not catch or wrap that reason.
